question_text: Does the combined void/web endpoint protocol contain enough frozen source-side and scoring-grammar material to make a go/no-go authorization decision?
Is it clear that the current readiness ledger has endpoint_ready_count=0 and that authorization would be permission to run one predeclared combined test, not promotion of existing pilots?
